title: Payout batching under-schedules one merchant depending on delivery order
summary: The nightly settlement report schedules atlas_supply below their pending ledger, and their payout is held until the number reconciles; the shortfall moves to a different merchant if the feed is reordered.

company.notes: Stripe bug-squash: reproduce from the oracle, follow the call path from an at-least-once payout feed through de-duplication into batching, and make a targeted fix without rewriting the packer; the symptom is intermittent with respect to input ordering.

expected_output:
=== Scheduled total (cents) by merchant ===
atlas_supply: 5500
delta_foods: 2500
harbor_books: 6000
north_hardware: 7000
sunset_bakery: 3000
buggy_output:
=== Scheduled total (cents) by merchant ===
atlas_supply: 1500
delta_foods: 2500
harbor_books: 6000
north_hardware: 7000
sunset_bakery: 3000

phase2.spec_patch: Compliance now needs held funds surfaced. Payouts with status `hold` are correctly kept out of tonight's batches, but ops needs a second section printed below the existing one, `=== Held total (cents) by merchant ===`, listing per merchant the total amount currently on hold, sorted by merchant the same way. The hold rows are already in the feed.
